zh: 账号与权限：账号列表新增分页、搜索、角色筛选及注册总数、今日登录与活跃人数等实时统计。
NetCare 数据探索：补齐运营商与代表处编码映射表元数据，查出原始编码时自动提示并映射为可读中英文名称。
en: Accounts & Permissions: Added pagination, search, role filtering, and inline stats for total accounts, daily logins, and active users.
NetCare Data Exploration: Enriched operator and rep-office code mapping catalog to automatically hint and resolve raw codes into readable names.
